reviewContext.coreQuestion: In PRODUCTION (FOUNDER_TEST unset), can the earner write a USDC number it did not really receive on-chain to the ledger the public dashboard reads?
reviewContext.answer: YES — via the HOME env var, because os.homedir() re-reads HOME in prod and moves the entire trust root (FIND-401). overallVerdict FAIL.

evidence.description: INV-2 (verified-earn-only) is violated in prod: the HOME-derived trust root lets a fabricated baseline=0 + real on-chain balance be recorded as an earning.
Static HOME assert greps literal process.env.HOME and misses os.homedir(); no prod-mode behavioral test for HOME poisoning.
os.homedir() honors $HOME on POSIX (libuv uv_os_homedir), defeating the prod gate.
realpathSync(FOUNDER_DIR) unhandled-throws when the dir is absent.
Hardcoded FOUNDER_WALLET_EXPECTED duplicates wallet.json state; bricks on rotation and publishes the address used by the FIND-401 attack.

The claimed core invariant 'prod trusts NOTHING from the caller' (file header lines 7-9) is not upheld: HOME is caller-controlled and still moves the trust root. The oracle cannot witness the violation because it only greps and never runs prod mode.

closedFindingsVerifiedThisRound.evidence: record-earn.mjs:46 adds a positive pin `wallet.toLowerCase() !== FOUNDER_WALLET_EXPECTED -> die`, rejecting ANY wallet other than the pinned address (not just the 2-entry SHARED denylist at line 39/45). Behavioral test case 10 (test-record-earn.sh:69-72) feeds a random non-shared wallet and asserts rc!=0. Caveat: see FIND-404 (drift/leak of the pin) and FIND-401 (a planted wallet.json can present the publicly-known pinned address).

record-earn.mjs:31-37 realpath()s the founder dir AND the ledger's nearest existing ancestor (lines 32-34 walk up to the first existing path), then requires realAnc to equal or be under realFounder — so a symlinked state/ escaping the body is rejected. Behavioral test case 11 (test-record-earn.sh:74-77) symlinks state/ to a temp dir and asserts rc!=0 and no write to the escape target. Verified the dashboard reads home+/state/ledger.jsonl (server.mjs:56), confirming the threat model. Caveat: realpathSync throws when the dir is absent (FIND-403).

record-earn.mjs:99-100 advances the baseline high-water-mark (writeBaselineAtomic(current)) BEFORE appendFileSync(LEDGER,...). A crash between the two loses exactly one record (honest under-count); a replay reads baseline=current so delta=0 and line 95 fails closed — no double-count. Behavioral test cases 8 and 12 (test-record-earn.sh:57-62, 79-82) assert baseline advanced + single row + replay-sees-delta=0. No double-count window remains.
